title: LootRush
description: Roulette chooses an item at random, players must get it before time runs out.
body:
#  LootRush — A Fast Minecraft Item Hunt Minigame

Race against the timer and be the first player to obtain the selected item.

---

##  Gameplay

A spinning roulette selects a random obtainable item.

Once the roulette stops, the countdown begins and players must find the target item before time runs out.

---

##  Controls

º → Start with default settings

N → Open Config Menu

---

## ⚙️ Commands

/lootrush start

/lootrush start @a 10s

/lootrush start @a 1m

/lootrush stop

/lootrush config show

/lootrush config time <10s|1m|300>

/lootrush config nether <true|false>

/lootrush config end <true|false>

---

##  Permissions

Server commands require OP permissions.

Singleplayer works normally without additional permissions.

---

---

## 🔌 Plugin Support

LootRush includes a Paper/Spigot plugin version that allows servers to control the minigame while players with the mod receive the roulette, HUD, timers and animations.
